intro: Top of the admins' Settings › Data API page. A data API token lets a script of the admin's own read and write the company's datasets (tables of records) over HTTP. "Shown once": the token's value is displayed only when it is made.
list.label: Accessible name of the table of data API tokens (read by screen readers).
list.token: Column heading: each token's name and its permissions.
list.madeBy: Column heading: the admin who made the token.
list.lastUsed: Column heading: when each token last made a request.
list.expiry: Column heading: when each token expires, or when it was revoked.
list.actions: Hidden column heading (screen readers only) over the Revoke buttons.
list.empty: Shown on the admins' Settings › Data API page instead of the table when no data API token was made yet.
token.usage: Under a token's name. {{scopes}} is a comma-separated list of permission identifiers such as data:read (not translated); {{perMinute}} is the token's budget of data operations per minute.
token.unknownMaker: Stands in for the name of the admin who made a token when that person is no longer known.
token.madeAt: The date a token was made, under its maker's name.
token.used: Last-used column: the date and time of the token's last request, then how many requests it has made in total.
token.neverUsed: Last-used column when the token has never made a request. Lowercase, like a table value.
token.revoked: Expiry column of a revoked token: "revoked" and the date. The _system form: the server revoked it on its own because the admin who made it lost the admin role.
token.expires: Expiry column of a live token: the date it stops working.
token.expired: Expiry column of a token past its expiry date.
revoke.action: Button: ends a token at once; it can't be undone.
revoke.label: Screen-reader label of the Revoke button; {{name}} is the token's name.
revoke.done: Toast after a token was revoked; {{name}} is its name, in quotation marks (use your language's).
new.open: Button on Settings › Data API: opens the dialog that makes a new token.
new.title: Title of the dialog that makes a data API token; also the accessible name of its form and of the field showing the new token.
new.description: Dialog text before a token is made. The token is limited to the company's shared datasets; it can never reach datasets that belong to one person, an AI agent (socio) or a plugin.
new.copyNow: Security wording: the token's value appears only now and can't be shown again. Keep this precise.
new.created: Shown with the new token's value; {{name}} is the token's name.
new.copy: Button: copies the new token's value to the clipboard.
new.copied: Toast after the new token's value was copied.
new.done: Button that closes the dialog once the new token was copied.
new.name: Accessible name of the field for the new token's name.
new.namePlaceholder: Placeholder of the token name field: suggests naming the token after the script or tool that uses it.
new.lifetime: Screen-reader label of the select of how many days the token lives.
new.days: An option of the token lifetime select: a number of days.
new.budget: Label of the field for the token's rate limit: how many data operations (queries or writes) it may run per minute; {{max}} is the highest allowed.
new.budgetLabel: Accessible name of the field for the token's rate limit: data operations per minute.
new.cancel: Button that closes the new token dialog without making a token.
scopes.read: What the data:read permission allows. "Field settings" are per-column display and validation settings of a dataset.
scopes.admin: What the data:admin permission allows. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area for a team's pages and chats).
errors.load: Error toast on Settings › Data API when the list of tokens can't be loaded and the server gave no message.
errors.make: Error toast when making a new data API token failed and the server gave no message.
errors.revoke: Error toast when revoking (ending) a data API token failed and the server gave no message.
